USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
WITH
-- 型1: 年代性別×カテゴリL1
type1 AS (
  SELECT '属性×カテゴリ' AS qtype, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.AGE_CATEGORY, t.GENDER_NAME)),2) AS pct,
         SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.AGE_CATEGORY, t.GENDER_NAME) AS denom
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2 t
  WHERE AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AGE_CATEGORY, GENDER_NAME, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
),
-- 型2: 性別構成
type2 AS (
  SELECT '性別構成' AS qtype,
         ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME='男性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct,
         COUNT(*) AS denom
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
),
-- 型3: 年代構成
type3 AS (
  SELECT '年代構成' AS qtype,
         ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1)),2) AS pct,
         SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1) AS denom
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, AGE_CATEGORY
),
all_q AS (
  SELECT * FROM type1 WHERE denom >= 1000 AND pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM type2 WHERE denom >= 1000 AND pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM type3 WHERE denom >= 1000 AND pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN pct < 10 THEN '05-09'
    WHEN pct < 20 THEN '10-19'
    WHEN pct < 30 THEN '20-29'
    WHEN pct < 40 THEN '30-39'
    WHEN pct < 50 THEN '40-49'
    WHEN pct < 60 THEN '50-59'
    WHEN pct < 70 THEN '60-69'
    WHEN pct < 80 THEN '70-79'
    WHEN pct < 90 THEN '80-89'
    ELSE '90-95'
  END AS pct_range, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM all_q GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM bucketed ORDER BY pct_range
